_comment: Backrooms collection: 'Still Life' copies from Kane Pixels' Backrooms. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with random.Random('kane-pixels-level-0').sample() from species whose model never changes with aspects.

readme.title: Backrooms (Still Lifes)
readme.summary: Pokemon re-imagined as Still Lifes from Kane Pixels' Backrooms: imperfect copies the Backrooms rebuilt from memory.
looks: colour drained into a sallow plaster / wet-clay palette under Level 0's yellow fluorescent light
damp blotches, clay grain and wobbly seams; rows of the texture slipped sideways like a bad copy
matte painted-on eyes with a second misplaced pair just below and a smear running down
no glow: glowing parts are switched off
shiny: its own Still Life, with a faint trace of the shiny colour showing through
